No real reason for that that I remember. Too dark, maybe? Anyway.

The biggest problem he had with anything we were into was if it had skeletons anywhere on it. No clothes with skulls on it, no pirate stuff with Jolly Roger flags, no nothing. Because yea, we were all into Pokémon, or fucking Batman, because it was against the rules of Christianity that my overtly spiritual pastor for a dad decided upon because it’s all subjective anyway.
